definition.description: The specific lobe of the lung that was surgically removed during a lobectomy procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the lung lobe specified as being removed in the surgical history, radiology reports, or pathology reports (e.g., 'right lower lobectomy' maps to 'Right Lower Lobe').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lobectomy is documented or if the specific lobe removed is not identified.
definition.name: lobectomy_type

definition.description: Findings from lung auscultation during the physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the described lung sounds or the absence of abnormal sounds (e.g., 'clear', 'wheezes', 'rales') from the respiratory/lung examination section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if lung auscultation findings are not documented.
definition.name: lung_auscultation_findings

definition.description: The histological subtype of the primary lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the histological type of the lung cancer (e.g., adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large-cell carcinoma) from pathology reports or diagnostic assessments. If only the broad category 'non-small cell lung cancer' (NSCLC) is specified without a subtype, extract that as the histology.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if histology is not documented in the record.
definition.name: lung_cancer_histology

definition.description: The overall clinical or pathologic stage of the patient's lung cancer.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the overall stage of lung cancer as a Roman numeral. Map sub-stages I and IA/IB to 'I', and sub-stages IIA/IIB to 'II'. Extract IIIA, IIIB, and IV as specified.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the stage is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: lung_cancer_stage

definition.description: Presence of a medical diagnosis of lung disease.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record contains a diagnosis of any lung-related disease (e.g., COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, etc.).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no lung disease diagnosis is documented.
definition.name: lung_disease_diagnosis

definition.description: Morphological description of the lung mass margins and shape.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the descriptive term characterizing the morphology (e.g., spiculated, smooth, lobulated) of the lung mass from the radiologic report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no morphological descriptor is provided.
definition.name: lung_mass_morphology

definition.description: Maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of the primary lung mass on PET/CT imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric SUVmax value specifically associated with the primary lung mass (e.g., right lower lobe lesion) from the PET/CT radiology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the SUVmax for the lung mass is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: lung_mass_suvmax

definition.description: Whether lymph node dissection was conducted during the surgical procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract from the operative report or pathology record whether lymph node dissection (LND) was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: If documentation is absent or ambiguous, represent as 'Not Performed'.
definition.name: lymph_node_dissection_status

definition.description: The total number of lymph nodes containing metastatic carcinoma.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the number of lymph nodes identified as containing metastatic carcinoma from the surgical pathology report.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lymph nodes were sampled or if the count of positive nodes is not specified.
definition.name: lymph_node_metastasis_count

definition.description: The presence or absence of lymphadenopathy, typically identified via radiographic imaging or physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if lymphadenopathy is documented. 'Absent' is indicated by phrases such as 'no lymphadenopathy', 'no enlarged lymph nodes', or 'lymph nodes within normal size limits'. 'Present' is indicated by phrases such as 'bulky lymphadenopathy', 'enlarged lymph nodes', or 'lymphadenopathy present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no mention of lymph node size or lymphadenopathy status is found in the record.
definition.name: lymphadenopathy_status

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
